{{Quote|I know you&mdash;friends of the Almas Jedi! Solenoid, we need their ship. Kill them!|Gura Tran, urging Solenoid to attack the heroes of Cularin|<ref name="DA" />}}
'''Gura Tran''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Tran infiltrated the [[Thaereian military]], the [[Army/Legends|armed forces]] of the [[Thaereian system]], and in around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] he was assigned to represent the [[Thaereian]]s in secret negotiations with the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Tran boarded a [[Unidentified Separatist CR90 corvette|Separatist corvette]] for travel to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] but en-route the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was [[Mission to the Ando system|bombarded]] in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]] by a [[Strike Force Cularin|Republic strike force]] crippled. Tran survived the assault and attacked a Republic [[Heroes of Cularin|boarding party]] sent to investigate the wrecked [[Starship/Legends|warship]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|She and the Human passenger seemed to know each other, but they kept pretty much to themselves.|Lieutenant Rame Cartroll, on Sheel and Gura Tran|<ref name="DA" />}}
Gura Tran was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="DA" /> who was born in around [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]]<ref name="Dates" /> and who served as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Tran was part of a small Believer cell and received little information on the cult's plans beyond what he needed for his missions. He infiltrated the [[Thaereian military]],<ref name="DA" /> the [[Army/Legends|armed forces]] of the [[Thaereian system]],<ref name="OT">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011004b_thaere&c=swlfc|text=Over Thaere}}</ref> and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was appointed by the [[Thaereian]]s as their official liaison to the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="DA" />

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Tran conspired with [[Sheel]], a [[Tarasin]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] of the [[Wyrd]] [[Coven/Legends|coven]], to devise a plot discredit the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;an [[Jedi Order/Legends|order]] of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]]&mdash;and the [[Cularin Government|government]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] by planting evidence implicating both groups in having had dealings with the Separatists. Carrying some [[Flimsiplast/Legends|flimsiplast]] documents and a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] setting out details of the plan on person within a [[magna-seal]]ed seem on his belt, Tran boarded a [[Unidentified Separatist CR90 corvette|Separatist corvette]] alongside Sheel to conduct negotiations with the Separatists on how the scheme could be implemented. Aboard the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], Tran and Sheel kept to themselves; few among the ship's crew, including the corvette's second-in-command [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rame Cartroll]] were familiar with the pair's reason for coming aboard the vessel, though the corvette's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] knew more. While en-route to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the Separatist ship made a stopover in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]] so that Tran could deliver some important information to a [[Separatist Ando system base|Separatist base]] sited on a [[Unidentified Ando system planetoid|planetoid]] in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="DA" />

Before Tran could call upon the Separatist base, the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] fell [[Mission to the Ando system|under attack]] from a [[Strike Force Cularin|task force]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], leaving the vessel crippled. Tran was one of only three [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings aboard the stricken corvette to survive the assault and around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the attack he consumed a vial of a [[Spice/Legends|drug]] that rendered the user immune to Force-based [[Mind trick/Legends|mind influence]]. Concerned that the wrecked [[Starship/Legends|warship]] was at imminent risk of depressurizing, Tran donned a [[padded flight suit]] for protection and he took shelter in a corridor leading to the corvette's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], accompanied by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] representative [[Solenoid]].<ref name="DA" />

The [[heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], boarded the damaged corvette to search for survivors and to gather intelligence. Recognizing the operatives as allies of the Jedi, Tran ambushed the agents, planning to [[Death/Legends|kill]] them and seize their starship to escape the damaged warship. Solenoid assisted Tran in his assault and the Believer spy stood behind the droid to use Solenoid as cover while sniping at the heroes of Cularin with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. However, Tran's attack was unsuccessful and he was defeated by the freelance agents.<ref name="DA" />

==Personality and traits==
Befitting of his vocation as a spy, Tran had a nondescript appearance; he was of an average build, [[Color/Legends|dark]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and was regarded as good looking by those around him, though not to an extent that would make him remembered by those he encountered. He was a fanatical supporter of the Believers and had a passionate hatred for the Jedi. Though a Believer spy, he also supported the Thaereian military with patriotic fervor; he viewed that Cularin, a planet policed by the Thaereian military, would be better off as a full Thaereian protectorate because he considered that the Thaereians combated crime and brought stability to the system.<ref name="DA" />

Tran was trained to resist interrogation and had formidable combat skills. When he became stranded aboard the wrecked Separatist corvette, Tran became desperate to escape though found that the conditions aboard the crippled vessel prevented him from utilizing his combat skills to his full proficiency. He was equipped with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] and a modified [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[DY-225 Heavy Blaster Pistol]].<ref name="DA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gura Tran appeared in ''[[Decision: Almas]]'', a roleplaying adventure by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] that was published by [[RPGA]] in [[2004]]. The adventure is set within [[Star Wars Legends]] continuity and serves as the first instalment of the [[Decisions trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] roleplaying campaign. In the adventure, the player characters roleplay as the heroes of Cularin and engage in combat with Tran aboard the damaged Separatist warship. It is possible for the players characters to capture Tran, in which case he refuses to disclose to his captors any intelligence. It is also possible for Tran to be killed in the fight and for his body to be taken away by the the Republic forces who then find upon his person the documents evidencing his plot to discredit the Jedi.<ref name="DA" />
